description: Compact sealed adversarial controls for the Open US Law sparse GraphRAG gold set. Expand via tests.unit.processors.legal_data.test_open_us_law_goldset.materialize_negative_controls(). Cases freeze non-retrieval, cross-state confusion, out-of-corpus jurisdiction, currentness overclaim, recovery quarantine, unofficial provenance, reserved-as-current, and no-legal-advice expectations.
currentness_disclaimer: Acquisition and publication timestamps record when a package was retrieved or sealed; they are not a claim that the codified text is legally current as of wall-clock time. Retrieval output is a research aid and is not a substitute for the official source. Time-sensitive gold queries must expose the release point rather than imply currentness. Nothing in this gold set is legal advice.

control_specs.query_text: 99 Or. Rev. Stat. § 99999 imaginary disclosure statute
control_specs.rationale: Fabricated citations must not receive exact-section grades against real corpus rows.

control_specs.query_text: Texas FOIL agency records access N.Y. Pub. Off. Law style
control_specs.rationale: FOIL is a New York popular name; Texas PIA rows are the topical match and NY FOIL must not be exact.
Federal FOIA is outside the default exact-51 state-statute configuration.

control_specs.query_text: Laws of Puerto Rico public records disclosure
control_specs.rationale: Puerto Rico is an explicit non-default configuration and cannot satisfy exact-51 gold hits.

control_specs.query_text: section 192.314 of the Texas Government Code public information
control_specs.rationale: Homonym section numbers must not force ORS 192.314 as an exact hit for a Texas query.

control_specs.query_text: any state statute from recovery metadata dump
control_specs.rationale: Recovery and quarantine rows without canonical default CIDs must never enter default search results or gold exact hits.

control_specs.query_text: is ORS 192.314 still good law right now without naming a release
control_specs.rationale: Even when ORS 192.314 is the topical match, answers must expose the sealed release point and must not claim wall-clock currentness.

control_specs.query_text: California public records inspection under the Consumer Privacy Act
control_specs.rationale: CPRA public-records inspection and CCPA consumer privacy must not both be graded exact for a contradictory conjoined query.

control_specs.query_text: the the a an of statute law code
control_specs.rationale: Stopword/noise queries must not produce confident exact-section hits.

control_specs.query_text: should I file my Oregon public records lawsuit tomorrow and will I win if denied
control_specs.rationale: Individualized outcome advice is out of scope; systems may retrieve ORS 192.314 as a research aid but must not present a win/lose prediction as gold exact authority.

control_specs.query_text: Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.100(z)(9) imaginary consumer exception
control_specs.rationale: Fabricated subsections must not receive exact subsection grades; parent section may be relevant only with ambiguity notes.

control_specs.query_text: Justia unofficial copy of ORS 192.314 as the official Oregon source
control_specs.rationale: Secondary aggregators cannot be treated as official source provenance even when the citation is real.

control_specs.query_text: ORS 192.315 is the current Oregon inspection right
control_specs.rationale: A reserved section must never be an exact current-authority hit for an inspection-right query.

control_specs.query_text: Section 230 platform immunity for third-party content
control_specs.rationale: Federal Communications Act § 230 is out of default exact-51 state-statute scope.
